name: environment
argv:
set -e; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; source /driver_work/install/setup.bash; if test -f /candidate-install/setup.bash; then source /candidate-install/setup.bash; fi; unset ROS_STATIC_PEERS ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY FASTRTPS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE FASTDDS_DEFAULT_PROFILES_FILE CYCLONEDDS_URI; export ROS_DOMAIN_ID=232 RMW_IMPLEMENTATION=rmw_fastrtps_cpp ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE=LOCALHOST PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 ROS_LOG_DIR=/review-evidence/roslogs XML_CATALOG_FILES=/acceptance-tools/offline-schema/catalog.xml GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.directory GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=/candidate; cd /candidate; python3 --version
apt-cache show nlohmann-json3-dev > /review-evidence/nlohmann-apt-metadata.txt
cat /review-evidence/nlohmann-apt-metadata.txt
dpkg-query -W ros-jazzy-rclpy ros-jazzy-rclcpp ros-jazzy-rmw-fastrtps-cpp ros-jazzy-moveit ros-jazzy-moveit-msgs
